items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Stan by the interviewee (Dave Brubeck). The mention of 'Stan' is solely in the interviewer's turn, describing a third-party anecdote.

ctx.x: So, great. Send Stan. Stan goes all the way there. Didn’t like something that somebody said. Turns around and comes back. Then is talked into going back, and gets on the next plane and goes back. He finally saved the situation. Now we have a friend that’s in Thailand for the King, to teach his kids.
Life is funny, the circles, because one of the Mills girls . . .
